learning_records.affected_invariant: A reproducible hash lock must install in a clean environment without consulting already installed build tooling.

learning_records.recurrence_signature: A require-hashes install succeeds locally but a clean CI resolver requests an unhashed pip or setuptools distribution.
learning_records.guardrail: Generate with --allow-unsafe, require pip and setuptools whenever pip-tools is locked, and verify with --ignore-installed --require-hashes.

verification_evidence.assertion: All six OS/Python matrices, provider authentication, quality and security, both rollback jobs, both clean wheels, and aggregate repository certification passed at the exact head.

learning_records.rollback_position: Preserve the generated lock, build-dependency validator, clean-install command, and mutation tests together.
learning_records.residual_risk: Package availability and advisories can change; exact hashes establish integrity, not future vulnerability absence.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Run the clean ignored-environment hash install before every dependency-lock acceptance.

learning_records.guardrail: Use one canonical query-key set, hash lookup-only session identifiers, redact complete sink mappings, and replay fixed counterexamples.

verification_evidence.assertion: All six OS/Python matrices, provider authentication, quality and security, both rollback jobs, both clean wheels, and aggregate repository certification passed at the exact head.
